intent: Keep only the variants of proband_calls.vcf.gz that lie inside the capture-panel intervals listed in exome_panel_regions.txt, which is a BED file (0-based start, end-exclusive).
silent_error: bcftools view -R decides the coordinate system from the file name: only a '.bed' or '.bed.gz' suffix makes it 0-based half-open, any other name is read as a tab-delimited file with 1-based inclusive coordinates (bcftools man page, -R: 'To indicate that a file be treated as BED rather than the 1-based tab-delimited file, the file must have the ".bed" or ".bed.gz" suffix'). The BED content named .txt is therefore shifted by one base on the left edge: the base just before each interval start is kept (3 extra variants). No warning, valid VCF output.
